image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a voluminous, dark brown curly wig. The wig features tight ringlets and significant volume, framing the face. The subject has pale skin, striking red lipstick, and is looking directly at the camera. The background is a plain, light neutral color.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is classified as a wig/hairpiece and not natural hair or another texture.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex curly hair and the background, and ensure the hair mass is a single connected component.
To analyze the realism of the hairline and the integration of the wig with the forehead/skin.

Edge sharpness of individual curls against background
